plugin.multiview.add_audio_title: Adds an AUDIO-ONLY cell (VU meters, no video) — pre-assigns the dedicated factory template (portrait format). Assign it an audio source in the panel below or via the Cables page.
plugin.multiview.add_clock_title: Add a clock / timecode (PTP, stopwatch or countdown)
plugin.multiview.add_image_title: Add an image (logo or background) imported from your computer
plugin.multiview.add_pip_title: Shows the first hidden entry of the bank again (its wired source is kept); assign it a source in the panel below or via the Cables page.
plugin.multiview.add_text_title: Add a text field (local text or TSL)
plugin.multiview.audio_source_title: Source feeding the VU meters (`meters` components of the PiP template, including the Classic fallback). Defaults to automatically following the audio stream paired with the video source above; can be forced to a different audio stream, or explicitly turned off (audio-only cell without video → no meter).
plugin.multiview.col_visible_title: A hidden entry keeps its wired source
plugin.multiview.copy_settings_title: Copy the window settings (position and source excluded)
plugin.multiview.export_title: Download this layout as .json (re-importable on another orchestrator)
plugin.multiview.fill_h_title: Tile selected windows to fill the full width
plugin.multiview.fill_v_title: Tile selected windows to fill the full height
plugin.multiview.flash_bank_full: Bank full: all {n} entries are already on screen (increase "Max inputs").
plugin.multiview.flash_copied: Settings copied (position excluded). Select the target windows then Paste.
plugin.multiview.flash_deploy_failed: Deployment failed: the displayed composition has not been applied.
plugin.multiview.flash_invalid_layout_fi: Invalid file: multiview layout expected ({name, config}).
plugin.multiview.flash_load_failed: Could not load the multiview. Reselect the instance or check the container.
plugin.multiview.flash_nothing_to_paste: Nothing to paste: copy a window's settings first.
plugin.multiview.flash_pip_template_relo: Template reloaded and re-pushed to the wall.
plugin.multiview.flash_select2: Select at least 2 windows (the last one is the reference).
plugin.multiview.flash_select3: Select at least 3 windows to distribute.
plugin.multiview.flash_select_mv_first: Select a multiview to edit first.
plugin.multiview.flash_select_targets: Select one or more target windows.
plugin.multiview.flash_template_short: Template {name}: only {n} window(s) in the bank — increase "Max inputs" to complete it.
plugin.multiview.format_changed_redeploy: Output format changed — redeploy to apply.
plugin.multiview.freeze_detect_title: FREEZE badge when the source picture has not advanced for N seconds
plugin.multiview.genlock_title: Locks the output phase to the PTP grid. Structural param: a change redeploys the container.
plugin.multiview.hint: Shift + click for multi-select. Reference = last selected (white frame).
plugin.multiview.label_proportional_titl: Text size follows the window size: = defined size when the window is 1/4 of the picture, then grows/shrinks accordingly.
plugin.multiview.layouts_empty: No saved layout. Compose a multiview then "Save current editor".
plugin.multiview.no_selection_msg: Pick a multiview on the left to edit its composition.
plugin.multiview.orientation_title: Portrait wall: composed vertically (1080×1920), then the engine rotates the image 90° into the landscape frame (panel physically tilted). The emitted stream stays 1920×1080. Structural parameter: a change redeploys the container.
plugin.multiview.out_format_title: Output resolution/rate. Comes from the system setting (Video formats); structural parameter: a change redeploys the container.
plugin.multiview.paste_settings_title: Paste the settings into the selected windows
plugin.multiview.pip_default_template_ti: PiP template applied by default to ALL windows of this wall (inheritance). Each window can override it (another template, or "classic dressing") in its panel.
plugin.multiview.pip_template_reload_tit: Re-reads the template from the library (Settings → PiP) and re-pushes it live to the wall — useful after editing the template while this wall stays open.
plugin.multiview.pip_template_title: Replaces the window dressing (name/tally/meters/ANC) with a template composed in Settings → PiP. "classic dressing" = the historical settings below.
plugin.multiview.remove_pip_title: Removes the PiP from the picture WITHOUT cutting its source: the entry stays wired and can be shown again.
plugin.multiview.row_toggle_title: Show / remove this PiP from the picture — the source stays wired
plugin.multiview.show_format_title: Discreet chip at the bottom right of each window: declared source format (e.g. 1920×1080p25)
plugin.multiview.show_no_signal_title: Shows a NO SIGNAL panel in the window when its source is missing
plugin.multiview.show_proxy_title: Engineering mode: badge at the top left of each window showing the pyramid proxy read and its cost (¼ ~ octave, 952×536 ✓ pure copy, full ↯ gather)
plugin.multiview.template_title: Applies a predefined grid to the bank windows (sources are kept)
plugin.multiview.tsl_central_help: Tally/UMD provided by the orchestrator's TSL service (Settings → Protocols → TSL).
plugin.multiview.tsl_direct_help: The controller (VSM…) must point at this multiview's IP, on this port.
